audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names one Zaahen ability — it says 'his key spell', 'his engage tool', 'Ultimate' — so a player has nothing to actually watch for.
audit.why: From the kit: Q (The Darkin Glaive) is a double-slash auto reset that heals, and its recast knocks up (10/9/8/7/6s). W stabs then pulls you toward him (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, 850 range). E (Aureate Rush) is a dash dealing percent-health damage — so armour alone is the wrong answer. R (Grim Deliverance) is 110/95/80s and heals off the damage dealt. The two immobilizing effects — the Q-recast knockup and the W pull — are the correct Riposte targets, which is exactly what the page's vague 'parry his engage' was pointing at.

edits.after: - Zaahen Grim Deliverance (R): 110s at rank 1, and it heals him — duel him once it is spent. - Aureate Rush (E): a 10s dash that ignores your armour. - His W pull: 14s — parry it for the stun. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Open patient — nothing separates you at 1-2, just honest auto trades while your kit comes online. Level 3 is your first real window: Riposte plus Bladework means his engage can be parried into a stun and a free vitals combo. But 4-5 belong to him — his cooldowns realign faster than your W, and he hunts its downtime. Trade only with parry up.
edits.after: Open patient — nothing separates you at 1-2, just honest auto trades while your kit comes online. Level 3 is your first real window: Riposte plus Bladework means his W pull or Q knockup can be parried into a stun and a free vitals combo. But 4-5 belong to him — his W is 14s against your 24s Riposte, so he hunts its downtime. Trade only with parry up.

notes: Zaahen's W has no name in either the kit file or the missing-interactions file, so I referred to it as 'his W pull' rather than invent one. His passive lets him revive when Determination is full — nothing on the page mentions it and I had no way to verify the trigger conditions or duration, so I left it out rather than write a rule around it.
